bio: What better place to indulge in the Great British tradition of Afternoon Tea than in the impressive surroundings of Chewton Glen? Sitting on the egde of the New Forest National Park, Chewton Glen is a 5-star luxury hotel set within 130 acres of lush, green countryside.  Afternoon Tea at Chewton Glen is always a decadent affair. Their Captain Marryat's Afternoon Tea comprises a mouth-watering selection of sandwiches and freshly-baked scones, followed by homemade seasonal cakes and pastries. All of this is served alongside your choice of loose-leaf tea, coffee or hot chocolate. If you're feeling fancy, why not upgrade to include a glass of Champagne?  Chewton Glen is located in Hampshire, just 1 mile from the sea and a short drive from New Milton train station.
